questions.question: Which among the following is a characteristic of an organized sector of the economy?

options.text: Jobs are low-paid and often not regular
Consist of small and scattered units which are largely outside the control of the government
There is no provision for overtime, paid leave, holidays etc.

questions.solution:
Characteristic of an organized sector of the economy are:

 
• Regular and secured employment.
 
• They are registered by the government.
 
• Follow rules and regulations set-up by the government.
 
• There are some formal processes and procedures and hence it is called an organized sector.

questions.question: Who among the following is an example of the Permanent executive?
questions.solution:
The permanent executives are:

questions.question: In which language did Gautama Buddha teach?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prakrit**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Gautama Buddha taught in Prakrit or Magadhi Prakrit language.
 
• Prakrit is a middle Indo-Aryan Language.
 
• It was spoken in India between the 3rd century BC and the 8th century AD.

questions.question: Where did Bahadur Shah Zafar die in November 1862?
questions.solution:
__

questions.question: Choose an animal which possesses an open circulatory system.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Circulatory System:** The system in the body by which blood and lymph are circulated.
 
• **Open Circulatory System**: In this system, there is no distinction between blood and interstitial fluid. It is found in crustaceans, insects, molluscs, etc__.
 
• **Closed Circulatory System:** in this system the blood flows always in particular vessels and capillaries. It is found in bigger animals.

 

 
 

 
 
Rabbit

 
 
 
Closed Circulatory System

 
 
 

 
 
Cockroach

 
 
 
Open Circulatory System

 
 
 

 
 
Lion

 
 
 
Closed Circulatory System

 
 
 

 
 
Whale

 
 
 
Closed Circulatory System

questions.question: The advantage of RBC's being biconcave is that ________.
questions.solution:
• The biconcave shape of RBCs is because of the interaction between its member proteins, i.e. ankyrin, Spectrin, etc.
 
• Biconcave shape offers the greater surface area for the gas exchange in RBC and to accommodate maximum space for hemoglobin.

questions.question: External forces ______.

options.text: may or may not be balanced

questions.solution:
• External forces: the forces caused by the external agent which are applied to the system from the outside of the structure.
 
• Features of external forces are:

 
• External forces may or may not be balanced.
 
• Deflection occurs in the internal system by the application of the external forces.

Examples: dead loads, live loads, etc.

questions.question: SONAR is based on the principle of ______.
questions.solution:
• SONAR stands for ‘SOund Navigation And Ranging.’
 
• SONAR is based on the principle of echo.
 
• Sonar is often used as a measurement of acoustic location and echo characteristics of the target object in the water.

 

 
 

 
 
Echo

 
 
 
It is a reflection of sound which arrives at the listener in multiple sounds after a specific delay of time

 
 
 

 
 
Resonance

 
 
 
Oscillation of system with greater amplitude due to the vibrating or external system.

 
 
 

 
 
Mass

 
 
 
It is the property of the physical body and it is also a measure of resistance to the acceleration

 
 
 

 
 
Velocity

 
 
 
The rate of change of displacement with respect to a frame of reference. It is a vector quantity.

questions.question: Water gas is a mixture of ______.
questions.solution:
• Water gas is a mixture of Carbon Monoxide (CO) and Hydrogen (H₂).
 
• ‘Water Gas’ is formed when steam is passed over red-hot coke.

 
• Water gas can be used to remove carbon dioxide from fuel cell applications. Also, it is used to gain pure hydrogen for the synthesis of ammonia.

questions.question: Which among the following shows unidirectional flow in an ecosystem?
questions.solution:
• Energy shows the unidirectional flow in the ecosystem.
 
• Energy enters the plants through photosynthesis during food making process.
 
• And energy is then passed from one organism to another in the food chain.

questions.question: From which state was the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana launched?
questions.solution:
• The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana was launched in Uttar Pradesh in May 2016 by Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
 
• The aim of this scheme is to provide LPG connections to women who are a part of families that are below the poverty line.

questions.question: Who gave the theory of Atom?
questions.solution:
• John Dalton, an English chemist, gave the theory of ‘Atom’.
 
• Dalton’s atomic theory states that all matter was composed of atoms.
 
• Atoms are the invisible and indestructible building blocks. All the atoms of the same elements are identical.

questions.question: With which country India has signed an open skies agreement, the first after the finalization of the civil aviation policy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Greece**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India has signed an ‘open skies agreement’ with Greece in 2016.
 
• The agreement aims to allow an unlimited number of flights from India to Greece whereas Greece is allowed to make unlimited flights to 6 metro cities in India.
 
• It is the first agreement after the finalization of the civil aviation policy which states that India can enter into open sky air services agreement with SAARC nations on a reciprocal basis.

questions.question: India and Pakistan have agreed on redesigning which Hydroelectric project?
questions.solution:

• ‘Miyar’ is a 120 MW hydroelectric project which is being built in the Indus river basin.
